changelog:
• VidSrc now uses vsembed.su (the previous mirror went dead) — blank player fixed
• Live TV: bigger buffer so jittery channels (e.g. Ind Kolkata) play smoothly instead of micro-stalling
• On-demand player: pressing DOWN no longer scrolls the video off-screen / goes blank
• TV search: added a Clear button so you can wipe the box without reopening the keyboard
